game_title: Arithmetic Cannon – Cinder Cone Camp Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ash wraiths.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ash wraiths. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the cooling vent using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the cooling vent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
